test_title: PYST 60: RRB Group D - Reasoning (Held On: 23 Dec, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question: Eight people – A, B, C, D, E, F, G and H, are sitting around a circular table facing the centre. Only two people sit between A and B when counted from the left of A. G sits to the immediate left of A. Only three people sit between E and G when counted from the left of E. C sits to the immediate right of D. F is not an immediate neighbour of G. Who sits second to the right of H?
solution:
**Given:**

 
• Only two people sit between A and B when counted from the left of A.
 
• G sits to the immediate left of A.
 
• Only three people sit between E and G when counted from the left of E.
 
• C sits to the immediate right of D.
 
• F is not an immediate neighbour of G.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/457f53af9fa8505ab93ebabfc369ad29095b4526d2ccbafffaa7acbf13c9a9c2.png] 

Starting from H and moving right:

H → G → **A**

So, the person sitting second to the right of H is **A**.

Hence, the correct answer is **Option 3 — A**.
